## Libraries

```{r download packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(psych)
library(qualtRics)
library(naniar)
library(zipcodeR)
library(maps)
library(leaflet)
```

## Load Datasets

```{r load data}

qt_raw <- read_survey("~/Downloads/Photovoice/R/Greenspace+Preferences+Survey+-+Positly_July+31,+2026_11.45.zip")

q1 <- read_survey("~/Downloads/Photovoice/R/Greenspace+Preferences+Survey+-+Positly_July+31,+2026_11.45(1).zip")
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptive stats}

# check that both datasets match up
dim(qt_raw)
dim(q1)
names(qt_raw) == names(q1)

# descriptive stats
skim(q1)
describe(q1)

# ex
table(qt_raw$gender...85)
prop.table(table(qt_raw$gender...85))

table(qt_raw$az)
prop.table(table(qt_raw$az))
```

## Missingness

```{r missing data}

# columns summary
qt_raw |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  glimpse()

# missingness graph
qt_raw |>
  select(age...84, gender...85, disability, housing_type, householdincome, income, az) |> 
  vis_miss()
```

## Map of Zipcodes

```{r mapping zipcodes}

# coordinates & zipcodes
zip_counts <- qt_raw |>
  count(zipcode, name = "n") |>
  mutate(zipcode = as.character(zipcode))

zip_coords <- zipcodeR::zip_code_db |>
  select(zipcode, lat, lng) |>
  mutate(zipcode = as.character(zipcode))

zip_counts <- zip_counts |>
  left_join(zip_coords, by = "zipcode")

az_map <- map_data("county", region = "arizona")

# static plot
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = az_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray95", color = "white") +
  geom_point(data = zip_counts, aes(x = lng, y = lat, size = n),
             color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Respondents by Zip Code", size = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.7))

# interactive plot
leaflet(zip_counts) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = ~sqrt(n) * 2,
                   popup = ~paste(zipcode, ":", n, "respondents"))


```
